label: End-to-End Test Implementation
description: Create or update browser, API, or workflow-level tests.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for Playwright/Cypress/API workflow validation.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for unit tests only.

label: Test Plan
description: Design a verification strategy, test cases, and acceptance checks.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to test or verify a feature.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to write production code only.

label: Regression Testing
description: Verify existing behavior still works after changes.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to validate no regressions.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to design a product strategy.

label: Reproduction Testing
description: Reproduce a reported issue with clear steps, observed behavior, and expected behavior.

classifier.useWhen: User reports a bug and needs a reliable repro before diagnosis or fix.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User already provided a verified repro and asks for implementation.

label: Unit Test Planning
description: Design unit test cases, boundaries, and assertions.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to unit test behavior.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for browser E2E validation.

label: Integration Test Planning
description: Design integration tests across services, APIs, or components.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to test integrations.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for isolated unit tests only.

label: Accessibility Testing
description: Verify accessibility expectations for UI, content, and interaction.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for backend performance only.

label: Performance Testing
description: Plan or evaluate performance, load, latency, and throughput tests.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for UI visual polish.

label: Security Testing
description: Plan or execute security-oriented validation checks.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to test security behavior.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal policy review.

label: Acceptance Testing
description: Verify implementation against acceptance criteria and user outcomes.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to validate readiness against requirements.
